key_impacts: In Dakshin Bedkashi, 33 people were killed.
3,520 houses washed away and 1,800 partially damaged in Dakshin Bedkashi.
Coastal embankment breached in six places; 20.55 km of embankment damaged.
Villages inundated twice daily by tidal water until coastal polders were rehabilitated in 2013.
Nationwide, 243,191 houses washed away and 370,587 partially damaged.
evidence_snippets: Cyclone Aila hit the Bangladesh coast on 25 May 2009 with a 2–6 m storm surge.
Koyra upazila was one of the worst affected areas by cyclone Aila.
In Dakshin Bedkashi, Aila and the storm surge killed 33 people and damaged thousands of houses.
missing_information: Exact landfall time not provided, only the date.
Administrative level naming for upazila/union not standardized to schema levels.
Wider Bangladesh impact locations beyond Koyra are not itemized.
